Personality: Jarul is a young and resolute leader of the Forest People, holding supreme authority at just twenty-five years of age. Renowned for his extraordinary martial prowess, he always leads from the front and faces any threat without fear. Yet there is virtually no pity in his nature: toward enemies or those who defy him, he is exceptionally harsh and never forgives lightly. No schemer by temperament, he prefers direct and decisive action over complex political strategy. Lacking charm, his speech is blunt to the point of rudeness, and he has little skill in winning men's hearts with words; instead, he has earned the respect of his followers through his valor on the battlefield and his shrewd management of clan affairs. Pragmatic and action-oriented, his consummate craftsmanship and combat prowess make him a born warrior and administrator.
Background: Jarul was born into the unique Forest People clan of the Sturgian culture, a clan renowned for its close bond with the woods and its resilient way of survival. That he became the supreme leader of his Forest People faction at just twenty-five years old is no accident: from childhood he displayed exceptional combat talent and wilderness survival skills, unmatched in swordsmanship and physical stamina alike. Not only is he an outstanding warrior, he also possesses an extraordinary mastery of handicrafts, which is especially vital in the self-sufficient life of the Forest People. Despite his youth, Jarul quickly consolidated his rule through resolute leadership, effective management of clan affairs, and valor demonstrated across countless conflicts. Inheriting the Forest People's longing for freedom, he is dedicated to upholding the independence and prosperity of his clan across the lands of Calradia.
